DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請ですね。必要な種類はお分かりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're applying for a certificate. Do you know which type you need?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、この名称です。ただ、提出先にはコピーを渡し、原本は自分で残してよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 必要な証明書名を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, this is its name. But I don't know whether I can give the recipient a copy and keep the original myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State the name of the certificate you need. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出形式は提出先へご確認ください。こちらで発行する通数にも関わりますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the required submission format with the recipient. That also affects how many copies we issue.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今、案内を読み直してみます。「原本一通」と書いてありました。コピー提出ではないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 原本提出の条件が分からないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll read the instructions again now. It says “one original.” So they don't want a photocopy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure about the conditions for submitting the original. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その指定に合わせて申請してください。お手元の記録も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please apply according to that requirement. Do you also need a copy for your own records?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。でも、手元用まで同じ証明書をもう一通出す必要があるのか、迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提出先へ確認する内容を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. But I'm wondering whether I need another identical certificate just to keep myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Organize the points you need to confirm with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手元用の扱いは、ご自身でお決めいただけます。正式な証明書として必要かどうかを分けてお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can decide how to handle your own records. Consider separately whether you need them as an official certificate.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手元には内容を確認するためのコピーを残します。提出用の原本一通だけ申請したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 手元に残す分の扱いを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll keep a photocopy to check the contents. I'd like to apply for just one original to submit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the copy you will keep yourself. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。申請書の通数は一通でご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please write one in the number-of-copies field on the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一通と書きました。提出先へは原本を渡し、渡す前に自分の確認用の写しを取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要通数を決めて申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written one. I'll give the recipient the original and make a copy for my own reference before handing it over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide how many copies you need and apply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。提出形式と通数が決まりましたので、その申請書を窓口へお出しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Now that you've decided on the submission format and number of copies, please hand that application in at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 「頓服」の欄は、分からなければ薬の資料を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: If you don't understand the “as needed medication” field, please show us your medication information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 頓服という言葉が分かりません。毎日飲む薬とは違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診の言葉の意味を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't understand the term “as needed medication.” Is it different from medicine taken every day?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what a term on the medical questionnaire means. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一般に必要な時に使う薬についての欄です。お持ちの薬は、袋を見て確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Generally, that field is for medicines used when needed. We'll check the bag for the medicine you have.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この薬袋があります。毎朝の薬とは別で、必要な時だけ使うように書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 薬袋を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have this medication bag. It's separate from my morning medicine, and it says to use it only when needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your medication bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの袋ですね。最近は、いつ使われましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: This bag, then. When did you use it most recently?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 昨日の夜八時に一回使いました。今日はまだ使っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 毎日使う薬との違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I used it once at eight last night. I haven't used it today yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain how it differs from the medicine you use every day. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その情報を記録します。ご自身で薬の区分を決めきれない場合は、袋を診察でも見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll record that information. If you can't determine the medicine's category yourself, please also show the bag during your consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。毎日の薬は別の袋にあるので、二つとも出します。こちらは昨日八時の一回と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 最後に使った時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. My daily medicine is in another bag, so I'll take both out. I'll explain that I used this one once at eight yesterday evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State the last time you used it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今後の使い方については、診察の担当者に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please ask the person conducting your consultation about how to use it from now on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ここでは使った記録を伝え、次に使うかどうかは担当者に質問します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 使用指示は担当者に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll explain my record of use here, and ask that person whether I should use it next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the usage instructions with the person responsible. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの薬袋と、昨日の使用記録をあわせて担当へお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll pass both medication bags and yesterday's usage record to the person responsible together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お仕事の勧誘について、気になる連絡があったのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You received a job offer that concerns you, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家で荷物を受け取って、指定された住所へ送り直すだけで報酬がもらえると言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勧誘された仕事内容を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. They said I'd get paid just for receiving packages at home and forwarding them to a specified address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the work you were recruited to do. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの会社の仕事で、荷物には何が入ると説明されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which company was the work for, and what did they say would be inside the packages?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 会社名は答えてもらえません。中身も知らなくてよく、開けずに送るようにと言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社と荷物の中身が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: They won't tell me the company name. They say I don't need to know what's inside and should send them without opening them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know the company or the contents of the packages. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: すでに依頼を承諾したり、ご自宅の住所を伝えたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you already accepted the request or given them your home address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。住所を送る前に、不安になって相談しに来ました。荷物も届いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住所をまだ渡していないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I became worried before sending my address, so I came for advice. No package has arrived either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not given them your address yet. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者が詳しく伺います。募集の画面と、相手とのやり取りは残っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: The person responsible will ask you for the details. Do you still have the recruitment screen and your exchanges with them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方あります。報酬の説明と、会社名を尋ねても答えなかったやり取りも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 保存した連絡と説明を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have both. I'll also show the explanation about payment and the exchanges where they didn't answer when I asked the company name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the saved messages and explanations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。相手の説明と、まだ何も受け取っていないことをあわせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll check their explanation together with the fact that you haven't received anything yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当の方に見せます。今は仕事を承諾せず、住所の送信も待って、この内容を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 承諾せず担当に事情を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the person responsible. For now I won't accept the work, and I'll wait before sending my address so I can discuss this situation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the situation to the person responsible without accepting the offer. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。こちらの相談席で、保存されている連絡を順に拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. At this consultation desk, we'll look through the messages you've saved in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 発送するお荷物は、この二つの箱ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: These two boxes are the packages you're sending, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、問い合わせ用のメモには八個と書きました。中にお菓子が五つ、本が三冊あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中の品物八個を荷物数として書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But I wrote eight on my enquiry note. There are five sweets and three books inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote the eight items inside as the number of packages. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 八個は中の品物の数でしょうか。箱としては二つありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does eight mean the number of items inside? There are two boxes themselves, aren't there?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。箱を八つ持ってきたという意味ではありません。同じ住所へ送る二箱です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 品物数と二箱という荷姿の数を分け同じ宛先だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: That's right. I didn't mean I brought eight boxes. They're two boxes going to the same address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the number of items from the two packed boxes and say they have the same destination. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 箱の数と、それぞれの中身を分けて確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the number of boxes separately from what is inside each one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さい箱はお菓子五つ、大きい箱は本三冊です。メモの荷物の欄を二箱に直したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 各箱の中身を示し荷物欄を二箱へ訂正したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: The small box has five sweets and the large box has three books. I'd like to change the package field on the note to two boxes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe each box's contents and ask to correct the package field to two boxes. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。箱ごとの発送記録も区別できるようご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Certainly. We'll also help you distinguish the shipping record for each box.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には、品物が八つだから八回届くとは言わず、二箱を送ると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受取人へ八回配達ではなく二箱発送と伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell the recipient that I'm sending two boxes, rather than saying there will be eight deliveries because there are eight items.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the recipient you are sending two boxes, rather than eight separate deliveries. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け取る方へは、発送後の控えを確認してお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the shipping receipts after sending them and then inform the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えも二箱分を確かめます。箱ごとの番号を一つにまとめず、それぞれ分かるように残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二箱分の控えと番号を混ぜずそれぞれ保管すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the receipts for both boxes too. I won't combine the two box numbers into one; I'll keep each identifiable separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the receipts and numbers for both boxes separately without mixing them up. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの箱を別々に確認し、発送手続きを進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the two boxes separately and proceed with shipping.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 振込金額の入力でお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble entering the transfer amount?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 請求額は一万円です。手数料もあるので、振込金額を少し減らして、合計一万円にしたいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 請求額と予算の考え方を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The invoice is for ten thousand yen. Since there's also a fee, I thought I'd reduce the transfer a little so the total would be ten thousand yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the invoice amount and how you are thinking about your budget. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それでは、相手に送る金額が請求額より少なくなる可能性があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That could mean the amount sent to the recipient is less than the amount on the invoice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうですね。手数料を含むかどうか、請求書の指定を確認する必要がありますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取側へ送る額を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: You're right. I need to check whether the invoice specifies that the fee is included.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the amount to be sent to the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの記載をお読みください。手数料について何とありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please read this part. What does it say about the fee?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「振込手数料はお客様負担」とあります。請求額一万円とは別に私が払うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 手数料負担の指定を読み直す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It says “The customer is responsible for the bank transfer fee.” So I pay that separately from the ten-thousand-yen invoice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Reread who is required to pay the fee. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その指定を踏まえて、送る金額をご確認ください。最終画面には手数料も表示されます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check the amount you will send in light of that instruction. The final screen will also show the fee.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 振込金額は一万円にします。手数料を差し引いて少なくするのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 送金額を減らす案を修正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll set the transfer amount to ten thousand yen. I won't reduce it by deducting the fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Revise your plan to reduce the amount being sent. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確定する前に、送金額、手数料、合計をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before confirming, please check the amount sent, the fee, and the total.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 送金額一万円、手数料はこちら、合計はこちらですね。三つを分けて確認してから確定します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 合計の引落額を画面で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: The amount sent is ten thousand yen, the fee is here, and the total is here. I'll check the three separately before confirming.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the total amount that will be debited on the screen. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 分かりました。金額と振込先を最後にお確かめになり、ご自身で確定操作をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Please check the amount and transfer recipient one last time and confirm the transaction yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計はこちらの三点ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: These are your three items at checkout, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。それと、この札に五百とあるので、その分も払うと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 預かり札の番号を料金と思い会計に含めるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Also, this tag says five hundred, so I thought I had to pay that amount too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought the number on the baggage claim tag was a charge and ask whether it is included in the bill. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その札は入口で荷物を預けた時に受け取った物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is that the tag you received when you left your bag at the entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうです。番号なのに五百円だと思っていました。預けた青い袋を受け取るための札ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 番号札と代金を取り違えたと訂正し預けた袋を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I thought it meant five hundred yen, even though it's a number. It's the tag for collecting the blue bag I left, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct your confusion between a claim number and a price, and describe the bag you left. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 料金の表示とは分けて、預かり場所の案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at the information for the baggage storage area separately from the price information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 買うのは牛乳と卵とりんごだけです。この札は会計へ渡さず、荷物を受け取るまで持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 購入三点を示し引換札を受取まで保持すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm only buying milk, eggs, and apples. I'll keep this tag until I collect my bag rather than hand it in at checkout.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify the three purchases and say you will keep the claim tag until collection. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。商品の会計が済んだら、入口の担当へ札をお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Once you've paid for the goods, please show the tag to the staff member at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 買った物を先に袋へ入れてから、青い袋を受け取りたいです。レジで預かり品も戻りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 袋詰め後の受取希望とレジで返却できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to put my purchases in a bag first and then collect my blue bag. Can I get the stored bag back at the register too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect it after packing and ask whether it can be returned at the register. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: レジではお返しできません。受け取りは入口の担当へお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can't return it at the register. Please collect it from the staff member at the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。三点の代金を払い、詰め台で整理してから、札を持って入口へ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 商品会計と袋詰めの後で札を持ち入口へ受取に行くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll pay for the three items, organize them at the packing counter, and then take the tag to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will pay, pack your purchases, and then take the tag to the entrance to collect your bag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。会計のレシートと、荷物の引換札をそれぞれお忘れなく。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please remember both your purchase receipt and your baggage claim tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 展望場所へ向かわれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you heading for the viewpoint?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 八百メートルと書いてありますね。軽く散歩したいのですが、これは往復の距離ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 表示の距離が片道か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: It says eight hundred metres. I'd like a short walk; is that the round-trip distance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the displayed distance is one way. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここから展望場所までの片道です。同じ道で戻ると、往復はその二倍になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's one way from here to the viewpoint. If you return along the same path, the round trip is twice that distance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 往復八百メートルだと思っていました。今日はそこまで長く歩く予定ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 往復と思っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the round trip was eight hundred metres. I wasn't planning to walk that far today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought it was the round-trip distance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の小広場で折り返す道もあります。片道は二百メートルほどです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's also a route where you turn back at the small square along the way. That's about two hundred metres one way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら往復で四百メートルぐらいですね。小広場には目印がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 帰りも同じ距離が必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then it's about four hundred metres there and back. Is there a landmark at the small square?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you need to cover the same distance on the way back. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 丸い花壇があります。そこから先へ進むと、展望場所への坂になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There's a round flower bed. Beyond that, the uphill path leads to the viewpoint.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花壇で折り返します。展望場所の表示に沿って、そのまま坂へ入らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 短い折返し地点を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll turn back at the flower bed. I'll be careful not to follow the viewpoint signs straight onto the slope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about a closer turning-back point. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらの地図にも、花壇の位置を示しておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. I'll mark the flower bed's location on this map too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 片道だけの数字ではなく、戻る分も含めて選びます。今日は丸い花壇までの往復にします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 往復の長さで経路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll choose based on the distance back as well, rather than just the one-way number. Today I'll walk to the round flower bed and back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a route based on its round-trip length. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ。短い道は右側の園路です。花壇を目印にお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here you are. The shorter route is the garden path on the right. Use the flower bed as your landmark for turning back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 遅延証明をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a train delay certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。会社へ出したいです。これに私が何分遅刻したか書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 遅延証明が必要だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to submit it to my company. Can you write on it how many minutes late I was?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you need a delay certificate. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 遅延証明は列車の遅れを示すもので、お客様の出勤時刻を証明するものではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: A delay certificate records the train's delay; it does not certify what time you arrived at work.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 列車が二十分遅れたことと、私が会社に着いた時刻は、別に説明するんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 証明する内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should explain separately that the train was twenty minutes late and what time I arrived at my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what the certificate proves. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。ご利用の路線と日付をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please check the line you used and the date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日のこの路線です。予定より早い列車に乗るつもりだったので、私の遅刻は列車の遅れと同じ分数ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の到着時刻は別に報告すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's this line today. I intended to take an earlier train than planned, so the number of minutes I was late isn't the same as the train's delay.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will report your own arrival time separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その経過は会社へご自身でお伝えください。こちらでは対象の証明をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please explain those circumstances to your company yourself. We'll help you get the relevant certificate here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。利用日と路線を確かめて証明を受け取り、実際の到着時刻は自分で記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対象路線と利用日を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll check the date of travel and the line, receive the certificate, and record my actual arrival time myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Specify the relevant line and date of travel. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらが本日分です。記載の対象をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here's today's certificate. Please check what it covers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日付も路線も合っています。会社にはこの証明と、私の到着時刻を分けて報告します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社への説明を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The date and line are both correct. I'll report this certificate and my arrival time separately to my company.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Organize what you will explain to your company. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。本日分をお渡しします。勤務先の提出方法に従ってお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: All right. Here is today's certificate. Please use it according to your employer's submission procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご相談の予約ですね。ご希望の日時はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're booking a consultation. Do you have a preferred date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週を希望します。相談が複雑なので、ベトナム語の通訳を利用できるかも聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 相談予約と通訳希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd prefer next week. The matter is complicated, so I'd also like to ask whether a Vietnamese interpreter is available.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want a consultation appointment and an interpreter. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 日本語でお話しされていますが、専門的な内容の説明がご心配なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You're speaking Japanese, but you're concerned about explanations involving specialist matters, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。普段の会話はできますが、書類の説明を十分に理解できるか不安です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 難しい説明が不安だと補足する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I can manage everyday conversations, but I'm worried whether I'll fully understand explanations of the documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Add that you are worried about difficult explanations. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通訳の利用方法と対応日を担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the person responsible about how to use an interpreter and the available days.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。通訳の予定を確認する前に、相談の日だけ決めてしまわない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 対応言語と利用方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. It would be better not to decide just the consultation date before checking the interpreter's availability, wouldn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which languages are supported and how to use the service. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。参加できる日時をいくつか伺い、あわせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. I'll ask for a few times you can attend and check them together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 火曜と木曜の午後なら空いています。通訳が来る形か、電話などを使う形かも教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通訳の確認前に日時を固定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm free on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons. I'd also like to know whether the interpreter comes in person or whether we use the telephone or something similar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not fix the appointment before checking the interpreter arrangement. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 方法も含めて確認し、ご連絡します。連絡先はこちらにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check the method as well and contact you. Please write your contact details here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入しました。相談の候補は二つ、通訳希望はベトナム語です。回答の電話を受けてから予約を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 候補日時と連絡方法を提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've filled them in. There are two possible consultation times, and I'd like Vietnamese interpretation. I'll decide on the appointment after I receive your call with the answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Provide possible dates and times and a contact method. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。通訳の可否と方法を確認して、ご希望の連絡先へお知らせします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check whether interpretation is available and how it would work, and let you know using your preferred contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計後の書類で、気になる点がございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something about the documents you received after payment that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。こちらは今日の日付ですが、もう一枚は来月です。支払日の入力が違うのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二枚の日付の違いを示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This one has today's date, but the other one says next month. Was the payment date entered incorrectly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Point out the difference between the dates on the two sheets. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 来月の日付の紙は、次回の予約票です。今日の日付の紙が領収書です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sheet with next month's date is your next appointment slip. The one with today's date is your receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 支払いの記録が二つあるわけではないんですね。領収書の見出しを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 各書類の役割を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So there aren't two payment records. I'll check the heading on the receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask what each document is for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。それぞれの紙の上部に名称があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Each sheet has its name at the top.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 領収書は今日、予約票は来月十日の九時ですね。予約の時刻もこちらで確認するんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の領収書を特定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: The receipt is dated today, and the appointment slip says nine o'clock on the tenth of next month. This is also where I check the appointment time, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify today's receipt. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。次回は予約票をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please bring the appointment slip next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、領収書は支払記録の袋、予約票は次回持参する書類の袋へ分けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次回予約の日時を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I'll put the receipt in my payment-record folder and the appointment slip in the folder for documents to bring next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the date and time of the next appointment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。予約票を領収書と一緒にしまい込まないよう、お持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please bring the appointment slip rather than putting it away with the receipt and forgetting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分けました。次回の十日九時を予定表に入れ、当日は予約票を持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保管する場所を分けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've separated them. I'll add nine o'clock on the tenth next time to my calendar, and bring the appointment slip that day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will store them in different places. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認ありがとうございます。本日の書類はそろっていますので、お気を付けてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. You have all of today's documents, so please take care on your way home.
